descFull: High-performance open-source anti-DPI / anti-censorship tunnel in Go. Hides VLESS/Trojan traffic behind a 16-mimic arsenal (SSH, TLS, mail, databases, cPanel/WHM/DirectAdmin/Grafana/Prometheus) in coherent personas. Real Let's Encrypt certs, full UDP/QUIC, TUN + transparent gateway mode, runs on MikroTik/RouterOS & Docker.
